0022600127.text: The Nuggets (1-1, 1-0 at home, on a W1 streak) host the 0-3 Golden State Warriors in Denver's third game of the 2026-27 season, with Denver 8th in the West and 1 game back in the Northwest and Golden State 15th in the West after three straight losses. Denver is without Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain), while Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandin Podziemski (back), Charles Bassey (knee) and Gui Santos (undisclosed) are day-to-day with game-time decisions.
